urls.rationale: §6B-1-3 Definitions — chapter-wide definitions used by Article 3 lobbying regime.
§6B-1-4 Remedies and penalties in addition to other applicable remedies and penalties — chapter-wide enforcement scaffolding that Article 3 penalty provisions sit within.

notes: Article 1 short title (1-1), legislative findings (1-2), severability (1-5), deposit of funds (1-6) are administrative scaffolding not specifically cross-referenced by the lobbying regime; omitted to keep precision high.
